rule: asked in Phase 11 order: recurrence frequency first, then mechanical equivalence, then freedom-preserving replacement, then placement. Task IR / Edit Plan / scheduler / retrieval protocol / ExecutionUnits / semantic authority are not reconsidered: no control evidence supports them (dependency vocabulary occurs 0x; authority concepts 0x).

comparisons.component: compiled spine (cells, sheets, used ranges, formulas, values)
comparisons.frequency: open_enumerate_sheets 46 scripts/12 tasks; formula_chain_print 45/18; 298 workbook opens; 639/707 prior-corpus scripts load per event
comparisons.replace_without_changing_choices: yes for fact retrieval; choice of what to look at stays
comparisons.note: agents re-open and re-scan because no persistent index exists in their environment

comparisons.frequency: PATTERN_ANALYSIS 14 scripts/4+ tasks; formula-group comparisons inside chain prints; ref_formula_map_build 7/3
comparisons.mechanically_equivalent: agent versions are ad-hoc (Counter over formula strings); harness version is conservative (opaque singletons)
comparisons.replace_without_changing_choices: yes as pattern/uniformity facts; no as correctness claims (candidate-choice negative result stands)

comparisons.frequency: DEPENDENCY_ANALYSIS 0 scripts; dependency vocabulary 0 occurrences; FORMULA_REFERENCE_ANALYSIS 15 scripts (single-level precedent prints, e.g. formula maps for XML edits)
comparisons.mechanically_equivalent: no agent equivalent of multi-level closure exists to replace
comparisons.replace_without_changing_choices: a trace/impact query would ADD capability agents lack (precedent-chain printing by hand), not replace existing work
comparisons.placement: optional query (impact/trace) + internal diagnostics; NOT rebuilt as coordination
comparisons.note: strongest asymmetry in the audit: the graph's value here is additive (break localization), not substitutive

comparisons.frequency: period_header_search 65 scripts/39 tasks (largest inspection pattern); year/FY/quarter regexes hand-rolled per task
comparisons.replace_without_changing_choices: yes; coordinate lookup does not choose targets (13_05 sidecar: solved with and without)
comparisons.placement: optional Python helper or query (periods(...)) — the single strongest helper candidate by frequency

comparisons.recreated_by_agent: yes, as the dominant mutation pattern
comparisons.frequency: translated_formula_gen 26/14; copy_formulas_across_columns 24/13; FORMULA_TRANSLATION_LIKE shapes 24/113 mutators; hand-rolled get_column_letter arithmetic in 19 scripts/8 tasks
comparisons.mechanically_equivalent: yes where one template + homogeneous targets (the +COND and content-target cases excepted)
comparisons.replace_without_changing_choices: yes if agent supplies program+targets (lowering); no if runtime guesses the program
comparisons.placement: transparent optimization (lower captured loop-fills) + optional helper (fill_formula(...))

comparisons.frequency: save_recalc_cycle 106/63; agents run their own soffice conversions (68 invocations); reopen_verify 52/20
comparisons.mechanically_equivalent: yes and then some (agent recalc is slower/manual)

comparisons.frequency: verify_or_diff_loops 77; DIFF_CHECK 14 scripts/12 tasks; diff_two_workbooks pattern 34/16; expected-vs-actual prints
comparisons.mechanically_equivalent: partially (agents check what they think to check; systematic error scan is additive)
comparisons.replace_without_changing_choices: yes as advisory layer; no as blocking gate (submit-miss precedent)
